JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT cp.subcategory, cp.category, sum(f.quantity) AS units
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id=118 AND s.store_id<>999 AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY ALL),
ret AS (
  SELECT cp.subcategory, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS ret_units_by_return_date
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id=118 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT sold.subcategory, sold.category, sold.units, coalesce(ret.ret_units_by_return_date,0) AS ret_units, sold.units-coalesce(ret.ret_units_by_return_date,0) AS net_units
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING (subcategory) ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 6
